judge.note: Self-evaluation by the authoring agent session; no per-type rubric defined in workflow aws-one-way-door — general judgment

categories.reasoning: Three named forces (hosting own assets, cross-tenant identity, aggregation-value features) with the plexusone.dev second-consumer insight making the problem concrete rather than aspirational
Tenancy, sync-contract privacy boundary, dogfood-first/no-billing posture, and first workloads are all stated as decisions, not options
Five goals map to the four phases; non-goals fence off billing, third-party tenants, local-loop migration, and cloud ACTS capture explicitly
No persona-level stories or flows (sync a project, switch tenants, onboard as friendly user) — partially a deliberate deferral to UXD, but the PRD carries none at all

findings.description: Add minimal user stories for the sync and onboarding flows, or explicitly reference the UXD deferral from the PRD

categories.reasoning: Measurable and honest (plexusone.dev renders with no visitor-visible change; private repos provably absent; two-tenant sync from one machine) but carry no timeframes — mitigated by the 6-pager's milestone gates
